categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in two segments: fluorine-containing new materials and polyurethane new materials. The fluorine segment includes production and sales of fluorochemical products such as fluorine refrigerants, fluoropolymers (notably PVDF), and fine fluorochemicals. The polyurethane segment focuses on the research, production, and sales of polyurethane products including polyether polyols and polyester polyols, mainly used in insulation and other industrial applications.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced chemical synthesis and polymerization technologies for fluorochemicals and polyurethane products. It utilizes industrialized processes for producing HCFC-142b, HFC-152a, PVDF, and various fluorinated olefins with proprietary patents. Production incorporates energy-saving designs, advanced DCS control systems, and patented catalytic and separation technologies. The polyurethane production involves high-temperature polymerization and formulation of customized polyether blends for specific insulation and foam applications.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include manufacturers in the lithium battery, photovoltaic, semiconductor, refrigeration, construction, automotive, and household appliance industries. The fluorine products serve strategic emerging industries such as new energy batteries, electronics, aerospace, and environmental protection. Polyurethane products are widely used in refrigeration insulation, building insulation, cold chain logistics, furniture, and automotive sectors. The company also exports to markets in Europe, America, and Asia.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with production bases in Shandong Province (Zibo and Ulanqab) and Inner Mongolia. It serves domestic markets extensively and exports approximately 19.46% of its sales revenue internationally, targeting Europe, America, and Southeast Asia. The company is expanding capacity and projects in multiple chemical industrial parks within China.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates an integrated supply chain covering upstream raw material production (e.g., fluorinated monomers), midstream chemical synthesis (fluorochemicals and polyols), and downstream product manufacturing (fluoropolymers, refrigerants, polyurethane foams). It emphasizes vertical integration and self-supply of key raw materials to reduce costs and ensure quality, positioning itself as a mid-to-downstream producer with upstream raw material capabilities.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding production capacity of PVDF and fourth-generation environmentally friendly refrigerants and foaming agents. The company invests heavily in R&D for low-viscosity lithium battery polymers, high-performance environmentally friendly coatings, and green synthesis technologies to reduce carbon emissions. It collaborates with universities on solid-state battery materials and carbon neutrality technologies, focusing on innovation in fluoropolymers, bio-based polyurethanes, and green chemical processes.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of chemical products including fluorine refrigerants, fluoropolymers, fine chemicals, and polyurethane raw materials. Sales are conducted via direct product sales contracts domestically and internationally. The company does not rely on subscription or licensing models but focuses on product sales with some government subsidies and investment income as supplementary revenue.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading domestic fluorochemical and polyurethane producer with early and significant capacity in fourth-generation refrigerants. It competes with other integrated fluorochemical industry leaders in China and globally. Its vertical integration, proprietary technologies, and diversified product portfolio provide competitive advantages in high-value fluoropolymers and environmentally friendly refrigerants. It holds a strong market position in lithium battery materials and insulation sectors.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 868.7 million, a 16.11% decrease from the previous year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 21.86 million, a 71.94% increase. The company has total assets of about RMB 2.55 billion and equity attributable to shareholders of RMB 1.96 billion. Despite revenue decline, profitability improved due to cost control and financial management. The company is investing in capacity expansion projects and R&D to support future growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its integrated industrial chain from raw materials to high-value fluoropolymers and environmentally friendly refrigerants, enabling cost advantages and stable quality. Its proprietary technologies and patents in fluorochemical synthesis and polyurethane formulations provide differentiated products with superior performance, such as low-GWP refrigerants and high-performance PVDF for lithium batteries. The focus on green chemistry, carbon neutrality, and customized solutions for emerging industries like new energy and electronics enhances its competitive edge and customer value.
